pr_title: ansible-galaxy - make collection/role page size and http error codes to retry configurable
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY
Fixes #79554

* Add per-server/CLI configuration for the page size
* Keep the current default page sizes for Galaxy (50 for roles, 100 for collections), but give servers more control. The default page size is the default from the server multiplied by 10 for collections and 5 for roles.
* Add server configuration option `retry_http_error_codes` to handle rate limit errors

Also fixes an issue where `timeout` defined for a Galaxy server was ignored.

* [ ] Tests
* [ ] Changelog

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Feature Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
ansible-galaxy

review_comments: i would just have single 'page_size' since we already have roles/collections swtich in cli to determine which one we are looking at. In config we can consider different ones, but i doubt we really need them.
I added 2 separate ones since roles and collections can be installed together, wasn't sure if someone might want different page sizes for them. But I can condense if you think not.
you can install both types on same run? https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/79442 would be solved then

Yes, you can as of https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/67843. I think #79442 is asking for a way to do that in a role to either give a better message or install (rather than managing the dependency manually in a requirements.yml).
 
You can install roles and collections together on the same run in a requirements file though and have the role use the collection. The dependency just needs to be managed manually.
Future refactoring note: this could benefit from using `http.HTTPStatus` where possible.
